meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计科学的实验方案，让结论更可靠
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在实验前拿不准怎么分组和随机化。
copy.tagline_en: Design rigorous experiments that yield trustworthy conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning an experiment and unsure about group assignment and randomization.

howto.what: 装上后,它会在你收集数据前帮忙做实验设计:按研究问题选择设计类型、做随机化与区组,用脚本生成可复现的分组表/试验运行表,并指出伪重复、混杂等设计陷阱。
howto.when: 当你在收集数据前问“怎么安排实验”“样品怎么分组”,或提到随机化、区组/分层、析因设计等词时,它就会介入;不用于算样本量或分析已收数据。

say.text: 我有60只小鼠,要比较A药和安慰剂,怎么随机分组?
say.note: 生成带随机种子的分组表,并核对每组只数。

say.text: 有7个因子要筛,请生成一张Plackett-Burman试验表。
say.note: 用脚本生成随机运行顺序的试验表(CSV)。

say.text: 样品分3批检测,怎么按批做区组,避免批次和分组混杂?
say.note: 以批次为区组随机分配,并打乱运行顺序。

howto.what_en: Before data collection, Claude helps design the study: picks a design type for your question, handles randomization and blocking/stratification, and generates reproducible allocation or DOE run tables (CSV), while flagging flaws like pseudoreplication and confounding.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a study before collection: ask how to set up the experiment, assign samples/groups, or say randomization/blocking/factorial; not for sample size or analyzing data.

say_en.text: Randomize 60 mice into drug A vs placebo — how?
say_en.note: Generates seeded allocation schedule with group counts.

say_en.text: Screen 7 factors with a Plackett-Burman design table.
say_en.note: Returns a randomized run-order experiment table (CSV).

say_en.text: Samples run in 3 batches; how do I block to avoid batch-group confounding?
say_en.note: Blocks by batch so assignment is not confounded with batch.
